# Environment: Python 3.12.3; NEURON 9.0.2; NumPy 1.26.4; SciPy 1.11.4; compiler /usr/bin/g++.
# Cell: diameter=10 um; default length=100 um; Ra=200; cm=1; ek=-101 mV; default gbar=40 pS/um2; vshift=0 mV.
# Source caller override: th_inact_inf=-52.6 mV; q_inact_inf=13.09 mV; unmodified NMODL other defaults retained.
# Mechanism mixture: prop_inact=0.85; prop_h2=0.4; h2tau_inact=450 ms; h2tau_inact_rec=2789.79 ms; inact_rate_factor=1.
# VClamp defaults (runIk sets dur[0] to total duration and plays the command vector into amp[0]): gain=100000; rstim=1 MOhm; tau1=0.001 ms; tau2=0 ms; fac=0.
# K_IV protocol: 20 ms at -140 mV; 34 test steps -110..+55 mV in 5-mV increments for 500 ms; 50 ms at +60 mV; 100 ms at -140 mV.
# Source activation window is (t>20.4)&(t<520); source inactivation window is (t>520)&(t<570). Current fit is attempted only when max(I[activation_mask])>1e-8 mA/cm2.
